strings.chapters.karawang.journal.options.0.text: I still reached for my work phone at every stop.
strings.chapters.karawang.journal.options.1.text: Someone made tea. I didn't have to explain much.
strings.chapters.karawang.journal.options.2.text: For a little while, all I had to do was ride.
strings.chapters.karawang.journal.prompt: The first night away. What stays with me?

strings.cutscenes.opening.departure.shots.0.text: The morning has room in it. I do not open the inbox yet.
strings.cutscenes.opening.departure.shots.1.text: Raincoat. Charger. Toolkit. The laptop comes too.
strings.cutscenes.opening.departure.shots.2.scre:
JAKARTA
Karawang ... Banyuwangi
A long way home
strings.cutscenes.opening.departure.shots.2.text: East, across Java. No need to do it all today.
strings.cutscenes.opening.departure.shots.3.scre:
JAKARTA
Karawang ... Banyuwangi
A long way home
strings.cutscenes.opening.departure.shots.3.text: The work can travel with me. One thing at a time.
strings.cutscenes.opening.departure.shots.4.text: Dad used to check the straps twice. I check them twice.
strings.cutscenes.opening.departure.shots.5.text: I brush the dust away. Dad always looked after this bike.
strings.cutscenes.opening.departure.shots.6.text: Behind Dad, the road always felt wide.
strings.cutscenes.opening.departure.shots.7.text: One familiar thing at a time.
strings.cutscenes.opening.departure.subtitle: Jakarta → Banyuwangi
strings.cutscenes.opening.departure.title: THE NEXT MORNING
strings.cutscenes.opening.morning.shots.1.text: Nine years in Jakarta. Most mornings know what to do.
strings.cutscenes.opening.morning.shots.2.text: The kettle. A cup before the road.
strings.cutscenes.opening.morning.shots.3.text: Work badge. Keys. The same shirt on the chair.
strings.cutscenes.opening.morning.subtitle: Tuesday / 06:40
strings.cutscenes.opening.morning.title: JAKARTA
strings.cutscenes.opening.night.shots.0.text: The apartment has gone quiet. Outside, the rain has stopped.
strings.cutscenes.opening.night.shots.1.screen:
New opportunities
Can we talk this week?
Your experience would fit.
strings.cutscenes.opening.night.shots.1.text: A recruiter. A former teammate. There are already other possibilities.
strings.cutscenes.opening.night.shots.2.text: The application can wait until tomorrow.
strings.cutscenes.opening.night.shots.3.text: The phone lights up again. Mom.
strings.cutscenes.opening.night.subtitle: Tuesday / 20:16
strings.cutscenes.opening.night.title: THE APARTMENT
strings.cutscenes.opening.office.shots.0.screen:
PEOPLE TEAM
Meeting room 03
When you have a moment.
strings.cutscenes.opening.office.shots.0.text: Nadia: Could you come to the small meeting room?
strings.cutscenes.opening.office.shots.1.text: A few steps to the meeting table.
strings.cutscenes.opening.office.shots.2.text: The meeting room is quieter than usual.
strings.cutscenes.opening.office.shots.3.text: Nadia leaves her notes face down. There is time to sit.
strings.cutscenes.opening.office.subtitle: A message from the people team
strings.cutscenes.opening.office.title: LATE MORNING
strings.cutscenes.opening.signout.shots.0.text: The badge stays on the table.
strings.cutscenes.opening.signout.shots.1.text: Nine years, and then a small message on a screen.
strings.cutscenes.opening.signout.shots.2.text: There is nothing else to carry from this desk.
strings.cutscenes.opening.signout.subtitle: Tuesday / 12:08
strings.cutscenes.opening.signout.title: AFTER THE MEETING
strings.dialogue.authoring_example.authoring.gre: Take your time. The road will still be there.
There is room in the shade. Have you come far?
strings.dialogue.slice.fuel.nodes.air.speaker: Attendant
strings.dialogue.slice.fuel.nodes.air.text: Air hose is beside the pump. No hurry.
strings.dialogue.slice.fuel.nodes.start.speaker: Attendant
strings.dialogue.slice.fuel.nodes.yes.speaker: Raka
strings.dialogue.slice.fuel.nodes.yes.text: Please. And could I check the front tire?
strings.dialogue.slice.guesthouse.nodes.night.te: Yes. Somewhere I can park the bike under a roof?
strings.dialogue.slice.guesthouse.nodes.roof.tex: Right beside the kitchen. Tea in the morning, if you're up.
strings.dialogue.slice.layoff.nodes.close.text: Okay. I'll hand over my notes.
strings.dialogue.slice.layoff.nodes.details.text: Of course. The notice period, severance, and reference letter. You don't have to remember all of this now.
strings.dialogue.slice.layoff.nodes.news.speaker: Nadia
strings.dialogue.slice.layoff.nodes.news.text: The restructuring includes your team. Your role is being removed. This isn't a performance decision.
strings.dialogue.slice.layoff.nodes.project.text: Another team will take it over. You've left it in good shape. I know that doesn't make this easier.
strings.dialogue.slice.layoff.nodes.reply.choice: Can you email me the details?
strings.dialogue.slice.layoff.nodes.start.text: Thanks for coming in, Raka. Please, sit down.
strings.dialogue.slice.mother.nodes.admit.text: Not anymore. They cut the team today.
strings.dialogue.slice.mother.nodes.answer.choic: Not yet. It's been a strange day.
I'll get something in a minute.
strings.dialogue.slice.mother.nodes.bike.speaker: Raka
strings.dialogue.slice.mother.nodes.bike.text: Is Dad still keeping the gate key in the same place?
strings.dialogue.slice.mother.nodes.home.speaker: Mom
strings.dialogue.slice.mother.nodes.home.text: You can just come home if you're tired.
strings.dialogue.slice.mother.nodes.honest.text: The company let my team go. There are other jobs. I just... haven't opened the messages yet.
strings.dialogue.slice.mother.nodes.key.speaker: Mom
strings.dialogue.slice.mother.nodes.key.text: Yes. And he still thinks I don't know.
strings.dialogue.slice.mother.nodes.mom.speaker: Mom
strings.dialogue.slice.mother.nodes.mom.text: Oh, Raka. Have something to eat first.
strings.dialogue.slice.mother.nodes.quiet.text: You sound tired. Is work keeping you late again?
strings.dialogue.slice.warung.nodes.far.speaker: Delivery rider
strings.dialogue.slice.warung.nodes.far.text: That's a few more cups of tea from here.
strings.dialogue.slice.warung.nodes.father.text: Dad helped me keep it that way.
strings.dialogue.slice.warung.nodes.rider.text: That a Thunder outside? My uncle had one. Yours looks better.
strings.dialogue.slice.warung.nodes.room.speaker: Sari
strings.dialogue.slice.warung.nodes.room.text: There's a guesthouse down the road. Green sign, just after the fields. They'll have a dry place for your bike.
strings.dialogue.slice.warung.nodes.start.text: Move your bag in a bit. The water comes off that corner.
strings.dialogue.slice.warung.nodes.sugar.text: You and my husband. He says that, then steals my drink.
Please. Less sugar, if that's okay.
Yes, thank you. I'll wait here a while.
strings.dialogue.slice.warung.nodes.tea.speaker: Sari
strings.dialogue.slice.warung.nodes.wait.speaker: Sari
strings.dialogue.slice.warung.nodes.wait.text: Take that chair. The other one's got a short leg.
strings.phone.calls.0.note: Mom asked whether I had eaten. I told her about the team being cut. She said I could come home. Dad still leaves the gate key in the same place.
strings.phone.messages.0.text: Let me know when you stop. Dad says check the tire pressure before you leave.
strings.phone.messages.1.reply: Thanks. I'm heading home for a bit.
strings.phone.messages.1.text: Heard what happened. I'm around if you want to talk. Or just complain about the coffee.
strings.phone.messages.2.reply: Thank you. Could we arrange a time next week?
strings.phone.messages.2.text: Hi Raka, a colleague recommended you for a senior engineering role. Your experience looks relevant. Would you be open to a conversation next week?
strings.phone.messages.3.reply: They're inside. The bike is doing fine.
strings.phone.messages.3.text: Rain here too. Don't leave your gloves on the seat. They take forever to dry.
strings.phone.photos.0.caption: I used to watch the road from behind his shoulder. He never seemed to be in a hurry.
strings.phone.photos.0.title: Dad and me
strings.phone.photos.1.caption: Raincoat, toolkit, charger. The laptop came too. One night in Karawang first.
strings.phone.photos.1.title: Packed for the road
strings.phone.photos.2.caption: Sari made room for my bag under the roof. A cup of tea, and time to let the rain pass.
strings.phone.photos.2.title: A place out of the rain
